chapter: First bands, Ennis, Thornhill and the Army
title: Army band service playing bass drum
summary: Gil says he tried to avoid overseas service and played bass drum in an Army band because the Army did not recognise his piano.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Oh yes. What did you do during the War years?
Tried to keep out of the most of (Army?) infantry, (LAUGHTER). I was in the you know, tried to keep from being shipped overseas at that time.
Were you with the entertainment branch?
No, I was in the official Army band.
Well were you playing an instrument with them or arranging for them or what?
Because they didn't recognise, the Army, they are slow, you know how those traditional things are, they are very slow to recognise anything except a military instrument.
They didn't recognise the piano, the guitar, string bass, all those things they didn't recognise.
How many different instruments do you play?
That's why I had to play the bass drum.
Did you? (LAUGHTER). You could at least beat on time, huh? (LAUGHTER).
Guys told me Yes, I was a fine bass drummer. (LAUGHTER).
